invariants.rule: Every native handoff preserves Skill id, version/version id, and sha256 digest.
Deploy confirmation must match the pending immutable version digest.
Deploy or binding pin does not install a keyboard candidate; Add To My Keyboard is explicit.
Only A-Z assignment mutations publish a validated, generation-bound local snapshot.
The IME resolves only an allowlisted local executor after exact binding identity checks.
Host and IME/extension reload a validated last-known-good or local snapshot after restart.

consumer_seams: SkillBuilderView Add To My Keyboard -> ShortcutRegistryStore.addPrivateSkill
SkillBuilderScreen Add To My Keyboard -> MainActivity InstalledSkillStore

claim_boundary: This evidence proves source wiring only. It does not prove device keyboard registration, process death/restart, physical long-press timing, third-party editor interoperability, network behavior, or store/release qualification.
required_external_evidence: Protected iOS physical-device install, keyboard switching, Add/assign/execute, and restart run
Protected Android physical-device install, IME enablement, Add/assign/execute, and restart run
Representative third-party editor matrix with accessibility and secure-field cases
Candidate-bound signed archive/APK and performance/lifecycle evidence
